rule: `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. If `m` is defined only on a superclass that is in the scan, the callee is `Superclass#m`. **medium**: the callee is named statically (Type.m(), module.f(), an import, `self.m()` inherited from a base outside the scan, an external library type) but is not defined in the scan.
notes: `self.save()` / `self.validate()` from Order: defined only on the scanned superclass Base -> `Base#m`, high. `self.commit()` in Record, whose base `extlib.orm.Model` is outside the scan: tier medium ("`self.m()` inherited from a base outside the scan"); the ID is `Type#m` of the enclosing class per the self rule, which C2 explicitly permits ("or is inherited from a base outside the scan"). The import line and class base lists are not calls.
